text:
Alex (Sales): Hey team, BigBank wants a short POC next week to validate streaming + function-calls + structured output for their transaction summarization flow. They care about latency, deterministic JSON responses, and security (no customer data leaves their VPC).
Priya (Pre-Sales): Copy — can you share the customer's primary integration language?
Alex (Sales): They prefer Node for the ingestion layer, Python for offline evals. POC scope: real-time streaming summary with a function-call to normalize fields, then emit structured JSON per transaction.
Sam (Eng): Ok. For streaming + function-calls we usually recommend the SDK streaming path and enabling function schema. Streaming returns deltas and then a final call payload. Example Node pseudocode I use for POCs:
```js
const stream = client.responses.stream({ input: prompt, model: 'rwd-3b' });
stream.on('delta', (d) => parseChunk(d));
stream.on('function_call', (fc) => { /* buffer fc.name + args */ });
stream.on('complete', (final) => console.log(final.output));
```
Priya (Pre-Sales): Important note: if you need strictly validated JSON per message, add a final non-streaming verify step to schema-validate the assembled output. Streaming chunks can be partial JSON.
Mia (Customer - BigBank): They also asked how to enforce that model responses match our internal schema (transaction_id, amount_cents, merchant_id, category).
Sam (Eng): Two options: 1) Use function-calling with a strict parameter schema (we map fields to types) — this gives structured args in the function call payload. 2) Or instruct the model to output newline-delimited JSON objects and validate server-side. For POC I'd demo function-calling; it's cleaner.
Jordan (Security): On the VPC/data residency ask: Hosted API can't meet air-gapped requirements. For BigBank we should propose Dedicated or Private deployment. Private (VPC) supports customer-managed networking and KMS integration. Also need to confirm retention: we can offer no-logging mode for PII-sensitive flows.
Alex (Sales): Good — include Dedicated and Private as options in the SOW. Pricing question from client: does streaming change per-token costs or add per-connection fees?
Priya (Pre-Sales): Billing is token-based for generation/embeddings. Streaming itself doesn't add a hidden per-stream token surcharge, but long-lived high-concurrency sockets may trigger Dedicated capacity needs (reserved GPUs) — that'll change the pricing model to committed capacity. I'll draft the pricing note.
Mia (Customer - BigBank): Also need a sample security questionnaire answered and an SDS for our SOC team.
Jordan (Security): I'll take the questionnaire. For the SDS/attestation: we need to know if they'll use Hosted vs Private. I'll prepare both templates: Hosted (data flows to Redwood), Private (customer-controlled). Expect 2 business days to fill.
Sam (Eng): For the POC repo I'll attach a small reference that shows: streaming client -> buffer function call -> call local function to normalize -> validate JSON -> emit to customer topic. Quick Python snippet for final assembly:
```py
buffer = []
for chunk in stream:
    buffer.append(chunk['delta'])
final = ''.join(buffer)
# if function call present, parse args json string
result = json.loads(final)
validate_schema(result, TRANSACTION_SCHEMA)
```
Alex (Sales): Thanks. Can we also show a fallback path if function-calling fails? Customer wants guaranteed output.
Priya (Pre-Sales): Yes — implement a small server-side validator + deterministic fallback: if schema fails, kick to a smaller deterministic model or run a simple rule-based normalizer. We'll include this in the demo flow.
Mia (Customer - BigBank): Timeline: they'd like a 30-minute demo on Tuesday 09:30 ET and a signed NDA first.
Alex (Sales): I'll send NDA. Priya/Jordan/Sam, can you do the demo? Priya lead, Sam for integration details, Jordan for security Q&A.
Priya (Pre-Sales): I can lead. Sam available for tech deep dive. Jordan - can you do 15m at the end?
Jordan (Security): Yes, available. I'll prep the two security templates and mark outstanding items.
deploy-bot: Deployment note: example POC repo created at https://github.com/redwoodinc/poc-streaming-integration (private).
Sam (Eng): I'll push a proof-of-concept branch with example Node and Python clients + README showing parse strategy and schema rules.
Alex (Sales): Action items: 1) Alex send NDA to Mia (today). 2) Priya prepare demo script + slides (Mon). 3) Sam push POC code (Mon morning). 4) Jordan complete security questionnaire (Tues AM). 5) Pricing note and Dedicated/Private options in SOW (Alex + Priya).
Mia (Customer - BigBank): Sounds good. NDA inbound. Looking forward to Tuesday. :thumbsup:
Alex (Sales): Great — will confirm calendar invite when NDA signed. Thanks all!"
